data.action: 跪坐榻榻米双手捧起青瓷抹茶碗向前递出，礼貌微笑
data.animaCaption: Kneeling neatly on tatami mats in a traditional tea room overlooking a bamboo garden, she offers a ceramic bowl of whisked matcha with both hands and a polite, gentle smile.
data.camera: 中景，平视，茶筅与竹林庭院背景
data.description: 拉门敞开望见竹林庭院的学院茶道社和室内，千咲正坐在榻榻米茶席上，身着酒红短披肩蕾丝领连衣裙，双手捧起青瓷茶碗礼貌递出。
data.lighting: 庭院竹叶过滤的柔和自然漫射光
data.location: 星炬学院竹林茶道社和室
data.promptProse: Kneeling in formal seiza on the tatami floor of the academy tea club with shoji screens open to a bamboo garden, Chisa presents a ceramic bowl of matcha in a burgundy bolero and lace-collared white dress.
data.title: 千咲 · 和风茶道社塌塌米茶室敬奉抹茶
